Over the past 3 years he has experienced a 12-pound weight gain. JT attributes this to his sedentary, 
high-stress lifestyle, and to dining out with clients on average 2 to 3 nights per week. JT is a non-
smoker. He drinks a 20-ounce (600 mL) cup of regular coffee every morning and two alcoholic 
beverages every evening. JT is married and has one daughter who is currently in her junior year 
of college.
